subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should the active config path ship as the proposed persistent Overview callout, or should the same value be placed in Settings or a diagnostics surface?
rationale: The canonical issue explicitly permits either location, while current implementation and history establish the data contract but not the intended permanent UI placement.

options.title: Keep Overview Callout
options.body: Accept the proposed prominent snapshot row as the fastest operator troubleshooting path after the branch is refreshed and live proof is supplied.

options.title: Move To Diagnostics
options.body: Render the same existing value in Settings or a diagnostics detail if maintainers want to keep Overview less prominent.

recommendation.title: Keep Overview Callout
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed prominent snapshot row as the fastest operator troubleshooting path after the branch is refreshed and live proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest broad Overview implementation on current main and are the strongest evidenced owner for the UI placement decision.
